T: Eight hours of suds. One long lunch break.
D: A single day in the lives of the workers at a busy Los Angeles car wash.
P: Serve the lunch when the crew takes a break between cars.
S: Spiced ground beef in corn tortillas with lettuce, cheddar and salsa
Beef mince cooked with onion, garlic, cumin and chilli, in warm corn tortillas with lettuce, cheese and salsa.

Raw peanuts in the shell boiled soft in a salty Cajun spice brine with garlic and chilli, soaked to take on the flavour, served warm in paper cups. Rinse 750g raw peanuts in the shell and put in a big pot with 3L water, 80g salt, 3 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 4 smashed garlic cloves and 2 dried chillies. Weigh them down with a plate, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 hours until the nuts are soft. Turn off the heat and leave them soaking in the brine for an hour. Drain and serve warm in paper cups.
Thick fries under beef and bean chili and melted cheddar
Thick fries double fried, covered in a beef and bean chilli and melted cheddar, chopped onion on top.
M: Dee-Luxe hot dogs with the works
Grilled franks in steamed buns with beef chili, mustard, onion and relish

Franks griddled until blistered, in steamed buns, topped with a spoon of beef chilli simmered with cumin, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish. Simmer 250g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, chilli powder and 150ml water for 20 minutes until loose. Griddle 8 franks and put in steamed buns. Top with the chilli, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish.
a soul food lunch on the break

Chicken pieces brined in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried crisp, with a creamy mustard potato salad and crunchy cabbage coleslaw. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with salt and hot sauce. Boil 800g potatoes until tender, cool and mix with mayonnaise, mustard, chopped celery and spring onion. Shred a quarter cabbage and a carrot and toss with mayo and vinegar. Dredge the chicken in 300g flour with paprika, garlic powder and pepper and fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 74C inside.
W: Fresh orange juice frozen around berries on sticks

Fresh orange juice sweetened with a little sugar, poured into moulds over frozen berries, sticks pushed in after an hour, frozen solid for 6 hours. Stir 2 tbsp sugar into 500ml fresh orange juice until dissolved. Drop a few frozen berries into each mould and pour the juice over. Push sticks in after an hour and freeze solid for 6 hours.
K: Fresh watermelon, lime and sugar blended and strained, over ice
Fresh watermelon blended with cold water and lime, strained and poured over ice.

s.note: Spiced ground beef in corn tortillas with lettuce, cheddar and salsa
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with an onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and chilli. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with the beef, shredded lettuce, 100g grated cheddar and a spoon of salsa.

s.note: Thick fries under beef and bean chili and melted cheddar
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince with a chopped onion and chilli powder, add a drained tin of kidney beans and a splash of water and simmer 20 minutes. Fry 1kg thick chips twice. Spoon the chilli over, top with 150g cheddar and grill to melt.

m.n: Dee-Luxe hot dogs with the works
m.note: Grilled franks in steamed buns with beef chili, mustard, onion and relish
m.how: Simmer 250g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, chilli powder and 150ml water for 20 minutes until loose. Griddle 8 franks and put in steamed buns. Top with the chilli, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish.

w.note: Fresh orange juice frozen around berries on sticks
w.how: Stir 2 tbsp sugar into 500ml fresh orange juice until dissolved. Drop a few frozen berries into each mould and pour the juice over. Push sticks in after an hour and freeze solid for 6 hours.

d.note: Fresh watermelon, lime and sugar blended and strained, over ice
d.how: Blend 1kg seedless watermelon flesh with 500ml cold water, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth. Strain into a jug, chill and pour over ice with lime wedges.
